context_for_next_testing_agent: Notify button rendering depends on `Notification` API + not-denied permission; in headless Playwright it is expected to be hidden. To actually verify the notify button appears, use a real browser with notifications available, or grant notifications via BrowserContext(permissions=['notifications']) on the page origin before load.
